firing_evidence.sentence: DCC offers multiple summer and fall raku firing dates where potters can fire raku kilns and work with reduction chambers.
firing_evidence.quote: Our summer and fall dates for Raku and Naked Raku are now online! Join us to fire our raku kilns, handle the reduction chambers, and reveal your glowing, ​one-of-a-kind creations.

sources.notes: These pages describe pottery classes and studio access involving wheel throwing and hand building, but do not mention wood, soda, salt, raku, pit, barrel, saggar, or gas reduction firings. The studio uses electric kilns for bisque and glaze firing only. No atmospheric or alternative firing methods are offered or mentioned on these pages.
sources.place_summary: BellyFire Studios offers pottery classes using electric kilns for bisque and glaze firing, with wheel-throwing and hand-building instruction, available through community group classes, 4-week workshops, private classes, and open studio access. A membership at their Mid City Mud location (24-hour studio) provides access to kilns and pottery wheels.

sources.notes: The user's note that VisArts is in Rockville, Maryland is incorrect; these pages are for VisArts in Richmond, Virginia. The pages describe electric kiln firings (bisque and glaze), a raku kiln, and a gas kiln. No dated workshops, firings, or crew calls appear on these pages. The Featured Clay Artist program mentions firing as a benefit (free firing + dedicated shelf space through December for the selected artist) but applications are closed and will reopen in May 2027, so there is no active opportunity to record. The pages do not describe any firing types beyond electric, raku, and gas reduction.
sources.place_summary: VisArts (Richmond, Virginia, not Rockville, Maryland) offers electric kiln bisque and glaze firings through community pottery firing and studio access, plus raku firing to studio access members and open studio users. A raku kiln and gas kiln are available in the outdoor firing area to those with studio access.

firing_evidence.sentence: An Olympic raku kiln is available in the outdoor firing area for studio access members and open studio users.

firing_evidence.sentence: The eight-week class meets Wednesdays from September 9 to October 28 and includes learning how to pit fire pottery in several class pit firings.

Pages show both dated workshops and ongoing classes involving non-electric firing. The Alternative Firing Workshop is a specific upcoming event. Fire & Form is an ongoing class during its session. The gas kiln is for enrolled students/independent study members only, not a separate firing opportunity for outside potters. Private events mention firing but are birthday parties/celebrations, not focused firing opportunities for serious potters.
sources.place_summary: Middlebury Studio School offers raku and pit/saggar firing through two main classes: "Fire & Form" (ongoing, alternative firing methods including raku, naked raku, obvara, horsehair, and saggar pit firing) and a weekend "Alternative Firing Workshop" (October 23-25, 2026, led by Bob Green). Outside potters can join the weekend workshop or enroll in Fire & Form during its session.

firing_evidence.sentence: The Alternative Firing Workshop includes raku, naked raku, and Obvara (Baltic raku) firings led by guest instructor Bob Green.
firing_evidence.quote: Explore Raku & Naked Raku, Saggar firing, and Horse Hair firing. Discover the rich textures and striking crackle effects of the Obvara method, also known as Baltic Raku.

firing_evidence.sentence: Fire & Form class includes saggar pit firing among its alternative firing methods students participate in.
firing_evidence.quote: Participate in multiple firings to explore a range of alternative methods, including Raku, Naked Raku (slip resist), Obvara, horsehair, and saggar pit firing.
